title: Takunomi's Haruto Hino Launches New Manga on August 30
content: Shogakukan 's Manga ONE service announced on Sunday that Haruto Hino will launch a new manga on the service titled Mizuki no Koibito (Mizuki's Lover) on August 30. The manga centers on two famous former child actors Mii-chan and Kei-kun becoming lovers.
author: ANN

title: Demon Slayer’s Next Anime Release Won’t Be Infinity Castle Part 2, But Something Else
content: After a little more than a year, Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle has finally arrived on the Crunchyroll streaming platform, setting a record that no one had hoped for. This is disappointing, as fans had been expecting the new trilogy films to release in consecutive years, and the lengthy delay has pushed the release of…

title: Ingoku Danchi Manga Ends on July 31
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kadokawa 's Dragon Age magazine announced on Tuesday that writer Sakusei Kenkyūjo and artist Yui Jōyama 's Ingoku Danchi (Indecent Apartment Complex) manga will end on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Attack on Titan Was a Major Inspiration Behind the Latest Game of the Year
content: Attack on Titan is undoubtedly one of the biggest anime series ever created, and it achieved that through its compelling elements. The series excels on many fronts, from its narrative and characters to even the intricate details of its character designs.
author: ComicBook

title: Naruto The Card Game Reveals First Trailer
content: In the past, the anime world has been finding its way into some wild new media to gain more success. One of the biggest examples has been the likes of Dragon Ball, One Piece, Mobile Suit Gundam , and Godzilla receiving trading card games of their own.
author: ComicBook

title: Gabriel Dropout Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content: The September issue of Kadokawa 's Dengeki Daioh G magazine announced on Sunday that Ukami 's Gabriel Dropout manga will end in its next chapter. Yen Press publishes the series in English and describes the story: A fallen angel with falling grades!
author: ANN

title: Shonen Jump’s Latest Ending Manga Releases a New Special Before Its Finale
content: Shonen Jump has seen many manga either get canceled or conclude this year alone, even though it has also welcomed just as many new series. title: Demon Slayer Studio’s Anticipated Film Unveils New Look As Fans Wait on Fall Release
content: Demon Slayer is often praised for its exceptional animation, which is why a majority of its success is credited to its stunning visuals. The studio that made it possible is Ufotable, one of the most renowned animation studios in the country.

title: 'You Got Me, Sempai!' Author Azusa Mase Launches New Manga
content: The September issue of Kodansha 's Dessert magazine announced on July 24 that Azusa Mase will launch a new manga titled Kumo Gakure Romantic (bottom left in below image) in the magazine's next issue on August 24.
author: ANN

title: My Hero Academia's Kōhei Horikoshi Writes New 1-Shot Manga
content: Kōhei Horikoshi ( My Hero Academia ) will launch a new one-shot manga titled Warawanaide yo, Shijima-san (Don't Laugh at Me, Shijima) in the combined 37th and 38th issue of Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump Magazine on August 10. The story will be a "boy-meets-girl horror" manga.
author: ANN
